edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the upgrader state variable inside initialize, establishing the privileged account.
upgrader_ parameter replaces the upgrader state variable in setUpgrader.
name_ parameter is stored into _name during initialize.
symbol_ parameter is stored into _symbol during initialize.
ipfsHash parameter is written into ipfsHashes.
tokenId parameter indexes the ipfsHashes mapping in tokenURI.
nextTokenId is copied into the tokenId local, whose value is returned and then incremented.
Local tokenId is used as the key when writing ipfsHashes.
nextTokenId is also used directly as the mapping key in add.
_msgSender forwards msg.sender to callers such as onlyOwner and _setOwner.
onlyUpgrader gates setUpgrader, allowing only the privileged upgrader to change itself.
onlyUpgrader gates _authorizeUpgrade, restricting who may upgrade the proxy.
onlyOwner gates add so only the owner can append ipfs hashes.
onlyOwner is typically applied to ownership transfer functions in the inherited module.
upgradeTo calls _authorizeUpgrade before performing the upgrade.
upgradeToAndCall calls _authorizeUpgrade before executing upgrade and supplied data.
upgradeTo delegates the actual upgrade and rollback test to _upgradeToAndCallSecure.
upgradeToAndCall delegates the actual upgrade to _upgradeToAndCallSecure with forceCall.
_upgradeToAndCallSecure performs setup and rollback calls through _functionDelegateCall.
_functionDelegateCall performs a delegatecall to a caller-influenced implementation, allowing arbitrary external code to run in the proxy storage context.
sendValue performs a low-level call forwarding all gas, which can reenter before the balance check is finalized.
functionCallWithValue performs a low-level call with value to an arbitrary target, enabling reentrant callbacks.

normalization_plan.reason: The name_ parameter exists only to feed initialize and should be absorbed into that initializer function.
The symbol_ parameter exists only to feed initialize and should be absorbed into that initializer function.
The ipfsHash parameter is consumed only by add and should be merged into that function.
The upgrader_ parameter is used only by setUpgrader and should be folded into that function.
The tokenId parameter is used only as an index in tokenURI and should be folded into that function.
newImplementation is passed into the upgrade entrypoints and should be merged into upgradeTo.
The tokenId local is a temporary inside add and should be merged into that function.
oldOwner is a temporary inside _setOwner and should be merged into that function.
The success flag is a temporary evaluated solely by sendValue and should be merged into it.
